CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an explicit presentation/organization (grid orientation and coordinate listing), and a distinct origin/status field are all provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to the same identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries identify specific content items (color-tagged sets) and their attributes (red/blue) for named referents.

D.rationale: For the same referent the text lists identified content (red coordinates) and separately provides an origin/status field, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report states how content is organized/presented (grid orientation and explicit coordinate groupings for referents).
